evidence_cards.content: At any point in an opening or closing sequence, the sequence shall be halted if: (1) A device fails to report completion of the current sequence step within the response time window allotted for the step; (2) The status of a closure device, which was previously opened at the current entrance, changes to 'unknown' or 'closed', without an operator-initiated command; (3) The status of a closure device, which was previously closed at the current entrance, changes to 'unknown' or 'open', without an operator-initiated command.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines specific exception conditions that halt operational sequences during execution — directly relevant to exception_flow as they represent error/unexpected condition handling paths.

evidence_cards.content: At any point in an opening sequence, the sequence shall be halted if the status of a closure device for the opposite direction of travel changes to 'unknown' or 'open'.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Additional exception condition specific to opening sequences involving opposite-direction devices — expands exception_flow coverage with directional dependency.

evidence_cards.content: To resume an opening or closing sequence after a halt has occurred, the operator shall be able to issue a command to resume if the offending device status can be corrected within a configurable time period as defined in the database and in non-volatile memory.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies recovery behavior following an exception-induced halt — critical for exception_flow as it defines how the system allows continuation after error resolution.
